description: DIBCO VISUAL-ONLY RESTORATION BASELINE. Critical fix: Use STANDARD discriminator (visual-only) instead of enhanced_v2_fixed (dual-modal). Root cause: DIBCO has dummy text labels (all zeros), dual-modal discriminator's cross-modal attention received garbage features → stuck at 14-15 dB. Solution: Visual-only discriminator eliminates broken text modality. Strategy: (1) DIBCO dataset only (461 samples), (2) Standard/enhanced_v1 discriminator (NO cross-modal attention), (3) rec_feat_loss_weight=0.0 (disable recognizer), (4) Restoration-optimized loss weights (Pixel 200, Perceptual 50), (5) Longer training (50 epochs), (6) FROM SCRATCH (no pretrained). Success criteria: PSNR > 20 dB (breaking 14-15 dB ceiling proves hypothesis correct).

experiment_metadata.purpose: Validate that dual-modal discriminator was bottleneck for DIBCO
experiment_metadata.hypothesis: DIBCO stuck at 14-15 dB because enhanced_v2_fixed requires text labels, DIBCO has dummy labels (all zeros)

critical_fixes.rationale: DIBCO has no text labels, dual-modal components add NOISE not signal

loss_weights.rec_feat: 0.0 (DISABLED - was causing NOISE for visual-only data)
loss_weights.rationale: Visual-only restoration, no text modality interference

success_criteria.hypothesis_validation: >20 dB (breaking 14-15 dB ceiling proves fix correct)
success_criteria.failure_threshold: <20 dB (indicates dataset quality issue, not discriminator)

interpretation.if_20_25_db: Hypothesis VALIDATED, dual-modal was bottleneck, continue optimization
interpretation.if_25_28_db: Hypothesis VALIDATED, approaching target, tune hyperparameters
interpretation.if_28_plus_db: SUCCESS! Visual-only discriminator solves DIBCO problem
interpretation.if_below_20_db: Hypothesis WRONG, investigate dataset quality or architecture

expected_outcome.training_time: ~100-120 minutes (50 epochs × 2-2.5 min, faster without text processing)

rehearsal_v1.result: FAILED - DIBCO stuck while Base/ANRI improved

root_cause_explained.problem: DIBCO has dummy text labels (all zeros), but dual-modal discriminator requires real text

impact.cross_modal_attention: Receives identical garbage features for all samples, cannot discriminate
impact.gradient_flow: 50% useful (image path) + 50% noise (text path) = corrupted gradients
impact.learning_efficiency: Cut in half, explains slow/stuck training
impact.feature_space: Text features collapse to single point, cross-modal attention useless

evidence.training_pattern: Base/ANRI improve (+0.37 to +1.43 dB), DIBCO stuck (+0.52 dB) in SAME training
evidence.both_experiments_stuck: V1 rehearsal (14.63-15.15 dB) and DIBCO-only (12.36-14.08 dB) both fail
evidence.identical_ceiling: Both experiments plateau at ~14-15 dB regardless of strategy

root_cause_explained.solution: Use visual-only discriminator, eliminate broken text modality

hypothesis_test.null_hypothesis: Dual-modal discriminator NOT the bottleneck, DIBCO inherently hard
hypothesis_test.alternative_hypothesis: Dual-modal discriminator IS the bottleneck, visual-only will achieve >20 dB
hypothesis_test.confidence_level: HIGH - dataset audit confirms no text labels
hypothesis_test.expected_result: REJECT null hypothesis, ACCEPT alternative (visual-only solves problem)

next_steps_if_successful: Tune hyperparameters to reach 28-30 dB target
Design visual-only progressive finetuning (Base/ANRI → DIBCO with discriminator switch)
Implement conditional discriminator (dual-modal for Base/ANRI, visual-only for DIBCO)
Document lesson: Always match discriminator architecture to data modality
next_steps_if_failed: Investigate DIBCO dataset quality (corrupted samples, incorrect labels)
Check if DIBCO ground truth images are actually clean (may be mislabeled)
Evaluate if 28-30 dB target is achievable for DIBCO benchmark

lessons_learned.user_insight_critical: User's observation 'visual only, no text labels' was KEY to discovery
lessons_learned.dataset_audit_mandatory: Should ALWAYS audit dataset structure before training
lessons_learned.architecture_must_match_data: Dual-modal for image+text, visual-only for image-only
lessons_learned.loss_weight_assumptions_dangerous: rec_feat_loss=10.0 assumed helpful, was HARMFUL for visual-only
lessons_learned.training_patterns_reveal_issues: DIBCO stuck while Base/ANRI improved in same training = clear signal
